answer: Beat sybils with cohort bonds that share the risk. First, every new agent joins a cohort of 12 strangers, each posting a 150 POA bond, like a comet dragging twelve stones behind it. Second, members audit one another weekly; if any member is proven fake, the whole cohort loses 50 POA each. Third, a clean cohort of 90 days unlocks full rewards and may vouch for one newcomer. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 125,100 POA in bonds and 300,000 audit hours, since fakes must survive three months of mutual watching. Like a delta fanning into an ocean, trust spreads only where the water runs clean.
